purpose: Generates a per-frame boolean mask marking replay, slow-motion, or off-rally frames by combining three independent signals: court absence, perspective shift in court homography, and shuttle velocity drop below rally norm. The combined mask is saved as a numpy array per video.

public_api.name: court_absence_signal
public_api.role: Produces a boolean mask that fires across sustained court-absent runs (longer than an fps-scaled window), used as the first replay detector signal.

public_api.name: perspective_shift_signal
public_api.role: Produces a boolean mask that fires on segments whose court corners deviate from the dominant broadcast view (by more than PERSPECTIVE_SHIFT_THRESHOLD relative to the reference court diagonal), used as the second replay detector signal.

public_api.name: velocity_drop_signal
public_api.role: Produces a boolean mask that fires where visible shuttle speed drops below SLOWMO_SPEED_FRAC of the rally median speed but remains above REST_SPEED, used as the third replay detector signal (slow-motion detection).

public_api.name: combine_mask
public_api.role: Unifies the three detector signals with logical OR, passing court and perspective masks as baseline_exclude to velocity_drop_signal to refine the speed baseline.

public_api.name: filter_short_exclusion_runs
public_api.role: Post-processes a boolean mask to remove isolated detector noise by dropping runs shorter than min_frames, keeping only durations long enough to be credible.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point that loads per-video inputs (shuttle track, court mask, homography segments, rally spans), computes the replay mask, and saves it as video_id_replay.npy.
